objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 04 — ASO audit: audit one product's store presence and produce a prioritized ASO action list. Read-only; web research only if extension tools are granted at start time with live catalog provenance.

steps.task: Audit the store listing of the product named in the kickoff message (find STORE-LISTING.md or equivalent under its product directory). Check: title/subtitle/short-description character limits (Play: 30/80; iOS: 30/30/keyword-100), keyword intent and coverage, claim-to-product truthfulness, screenshot copy discipline, what's-new quality. Return per-store findings with exact character counts. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Provide market context for the product named in the kickoff message: 5 closest competitors with their listing positioning and pricing, and 3 keyword opportunities. If live web tools are not granted, work from local evidence and the brief, and mark items needing live verification. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Reduce both lanes into a prioritized ASO action list: quick wins (today), tests (this week), strategic shifts (this month). Each item: action, expected metric impact, effort, owner role. Always respond in English.
